id: \bThis town used to raise ninjas. You won't find any now though.
en: \bThis town used to raise ninjas. You won't find any now though.
it: \bUn tempo questa città addestrava ninja. Ormai però non ne troverai più.

id: \bThe Lake of Rage was attacked?! Who would do such a thing?
en: \bThe Lake of Rage was attacked?! Who would do such a thing?
it: \bIl Lago d'Ira è stato attaccato?! Chi potrebbe fare una cosa simile?

id: \bIf you keep going east you will come across the Ice Cave, where many Ice types live.
en: \bIf you keep going east you will come across the Ice Cave, where many Ice types live.
it: \bSe continui verso est arriverai alla Grotta Ghiacciata, dove vivono molti Pokémon di tipo Ghiaccio.
